svg.title: factory records fete poster
svg.text: Brindlewick Cricket Club, Hawthorn Lane, Brindlewick
In aid of St. Peter's Church Restoration Fund
Live folk music from The Muddy Boots
Organised by Brindlewick Village Community Association.

g.data-flaw: The title is set twice in a hairline face while the original's giant Fete is left broken in the artwork.
g.data-outlook: Probably fixable with a fresh attempt: override the title face and treat the giant Fete as a line of its own.
g.title: I know this conversion is flawed. The title is set twice in a hairline face while the original's giant Fete is left broken in the artwork. Probably fixable with a fresh attempt: override the title face and treat the giant Fete as a line of its own.
